messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["bear", "beetle"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "The creature is a large four-legged animal standing in profile facing right. It has the furry head, ears, legs, paws, and small tail of a brown bear, but most of its torso and legs are covered in a glossy dark brown segmented exoskeleton like a beetle. A long glossy black curved horn with a small barb rises from its forehead and arches forward over its head. The back is covered by a dark domed segmented carapace, the sides of the belly show pale tan segmented insect-like skin with breathing holes, and large smooth dark shields cover the shoulders and hips with stacked ring armor down the legs to furry clawed bear paws.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "brown furry bear head with lighter tan muzzle, black nose, brown eyes and closed mouth", "part": "head", "where": "at the front of the creature"}, {"looks_like": "long glossy black curved beetle horn with a small point on the underside", "part": "horn", "where": "growing from the center of the forehead and arching up and forward over the head"}, {"looks_like": "small rounded furry brown bear ears", "part": "ears", "where": "on top of the head on either side of the base of the horn"}, {"looks_like": "thick furry brown limbs encased in glossy dark brown stacked armor", "part": "legs", "where": "four legs under the body, two in front and two in rear"}, {"looks_like": "broad furry brown bear paws with long dark claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the bottom of each leg below the armor"}, {"looks_like": "small furry brown tuft", "part": "tail", "where": "at the rear of the body behind the shell"}, {"looks_like": "glossy dark brown overlapping segmented beetle carapace", "part": "shell", "where": "covering the back from behind the head to the rear"}, {"looks_like": "pale tan segmented insect abdomen with two rows of oval holes along the upper side", "part": "underside", "where": "along the side and belly of the torso beneath the dark shell"}, {"looks_like": "large smooth glossy dark brown shields with stacked ring segments below", "part": "leg plates", "where": "over the upper front and upper rear legs and down the legs"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
